Luxury Cave Hotel in Cappadocia | Kayakapi Premium Caves
Kayakapi Premium Caves - Cappadocia is an award-winning luxury cave hotel in Cappadocia, located in the center of Ürgüp, Cappadocia. Set within a restored private historical hillside neighborhood, it offers one of the largest and most private luxury cave hotel experiences in Cappadocia, combining authentic cave architecture with modern comfort.
Built across one of the oldest settlement areas in the region, the hotel features hundreds of restored cave houses and historical structures, creating a unique living heritage environment. Guests stay within a living heritage environment, surrounded by cultural landmarks including a 10th-century cave church, an Ottoman-era mosque, and the House of St. John the Russian, all with panoramic views over Ürgüp and the surrounding valleys.
Kayakapi Premium Caves - Cappadocia is also home to Revithia, a Michelin-starred restaurant offering refined cuisine inspired by Anatolian and Cappadocian traditions, establishing the hotel as a complete luxury destination in Cappadocia.

REVITHIA
Cappadocia’s First and Only Michelin-Starred Restaurant
Gault & Millau / Gourmand Table Award Winner: Revithia derives from the Greek word of "chickpea" which is our inspiration for Cappadocia's "first & only" tasting menu restaurant located within Kayakapi Premium Caves - Cappadocia. We are proud to serve forgotten Cappadocian local dishes with a modern touch; paired with Cappadocian terra noir wines from local wine producers.
-->
Located inside the award-winning Kayakapi Premium Caves - Cappadocia, Revithia is one of the region’s foremost culinary destinations. The restaurant reinterprets Turkish, Greek, and Armenian flavors through a modern, innovative lens. Its name, “Revithia” (chickpea) , reflects transformation and the timeless tastes of Anatolia.
As Cappadocia’s first and only Michelin-starred tasting menu restaurant , Revithia offers a seasonally changing menu crafted from fresh local ingredients and heritage recipes. Each course bridges past and present, creating an elegant and memorable Cappadocian gastronomic experience.
Our curated wine pairings feature volcanic-soil Cappadocian wines , enhancing the tasting menu with distinctive regional character.
Guests may dine in our intimate historic cave setting or enjoy panoramic views of Ürgüp from the terrace. Revithia is ideal for culinary travelers, special occasions, and those seeking an exceptional taste of Cappadocia.
Experience Revithia; details and reservations here.
Kayakapi Premium Caves – Cappadocia is recognized among the world’s leading luxury hotels, with distinctions including TripAdvisor Travelers’ Choice Best of the Best rankings and global guest awards.
As the first officially licensed boutique hotel by the Turkish Ministry of Culture and Tourism, the property combines a restored historical neighborhood, expansive suites and mansions, and Michelin-starred dining at Revithia.
Together, these elements create one of the most complete and distinctive luxury cave hotel experiences in Cappadocia.
